name: Admitted Patients
query:
SELECT
    ip.patient AS "Patient:Data:120",
    ip.patient_name AS "Patient Name:Data:220",
    ip.room AS "Room:Data:160",
    ip.bed AS "Bed:Data:160",
    ip.admission_practitioner AS "Consultant:Data:200",
    ip.status AS "Status:Data:120",
    1 AS "Qty:Int:60"
FROM `tabInpatient Record` ip
WHERE ip.status = 'Admitted'
ORDER BY ip.room, ip.bed, ip.patient_name
